name.label: Username
name.description: The name of the user account on the local device.

type.label: Type
type.description: The type of the user account.

lastSeen.label: Last seen
lastSeen.description: The date and time of the last user account activity received by the Nexthink instance.

userPrincipleName.label: UPN
userPrincipleName.description: The User Principal Name (UPN), a unique identifier for a user account.

adUsername.label: AD Username
adUsername.description: The name of the user account as it appears in Entra ID.

adUserFullName.label: AD -> Full name
adUserFullName.description: The name displayed in the address book for the user. This is usually the combination of the user's first name, middle initial and last name.

adDepartment.label: AD -> Department
adDepartment.description: The name of the department the user is associated with.

adJobTitle.label: AD -> Job title
adJobTitle.description: The job title assigned to the user in Active Directory.

adCity.label: AD -> City
adCity.description: The name of the city the user is associated with.

adOffice.label: AD -> Office
adOffice.description: The name of the physical location or office the user is associated with.
